nextStep.writingBanner: Tutorial: give a writing prompt a try
nextStep.finishBanner: Well done! Your Korean journey starts here — we're cheering you on!

hangul-nav.askBody: Hangul is the Korean alphabet — the very first thing to learn. Want to have a look?
hangul-nav.title: Tap Hangul
hangul-nav.body: It's right here in the menu — tap it to open the alphabet.

hangul-pick.title: Tap ㄱ
hangul-pick.body: Tap the first letter — you'll hear how it sounds.

hangul-stroke.title: Watch the strokes
hangul-stroke.body: This box draws the letter stroke by stroke. Tap it to watch again and hear it — then we'll move on.

hangul-nav-vocab.askTitle: Now, shall we look at Vocabulary?
hangul-nav-vocab.askBody: That's where you'll learn real words, chapter by chapter.
hangul-nav-vocab.title: Tap Vocabulary
hangul-nav-vocab.body: It's in the menu — tap it to go there.

vocab-chapter.title: Chapters
vocab-chapter.body: Vocabulary is split into chapters of 50 words. Pick any one up here.

vocab-days.title: Five days per chapter
vocab-days.body: Each chapter is broken into Day 1–5, ten words a day — a comfortable daily bite.

vocab-word.title: Open the first word
vocab-word.body: Tap the first word of Day 1 to see it up close.

word-box.title: The word card
word-box.body: Here's the word, its meaning, and an example sentence. Tap the 🔊 to hear any of it.

word-goti.title: Read it, then tap Got it
word-goti.body: Take a second with the word, then tap Got it — that's how a word starts moving up your review boxes.

word-bank.title: Save it for later
word-bank.body: Add to My Words keeps a word in your personal word bank so you can review it any time.

shop-nav.askTitle: One last stop — want to see the Shop?
shop-nav.askBody: Spend the coins you earn on outfits for your tree.
shop-nav.title: Tap Shop
shop-nav.body: It's in the menu — tap it to open the shop.

shop-coins.title: Your coins
shop-coins.body: This is your balance. Daily quests and level-ups earn you more.

shop-tabs.title: Categories
shop-tabs.body: Hats, faces, auras, sky, ground, friends — every kind of item has its own tab.

shop-pick.title: Try one on
shop-pick.body: Tap an item to preview it on your tree.

shop-tryon.title: Try-on preview
shop-tryon.body: Your tree shows what you've picked before you buy anything.

shop-cta.title: Buy & wear
shop-cta.body: When you like the look, this button buys it and puts it on your tree.

finish.title: You made it through the tutorial! 🎉
finish.body:
Practice has a lot more waiting for you — listening, speaking, writing and reading. Build up your skills and take them on.

We're cheering for your Korean journey. 화이팅!

welcome.title: Welcome to Kroot! 👋
welcome.body: Since it's your first time here, let me show you around one thing at a time.

sidebar.title: Your menu
sidebar.body: Everything you can practice lives here.

basics.title: Basics
basics.body: Hangul, grammar, and vocabulary — the foundation.

practice.title: Practice — your training ground
practice.body: Basics teaches the pieces. This is where you actually use them, every day.

relax.title: Relax — try Slang
relax.body: Real expressions Korean speakers actually use, not in any textbook.

tree.title: Your tree grows with you
tree.body: Your name, level, and streak live here — and so does your tree.

quest.title: Start with today's quest
quest.body: One clear thing to do each day.

garden.title: Watch your garden fill in
garden.body: Every study day adds a tile. Keep the streak alive.
